✍️I am a S.Q.A & NABET Certified Personal development coach, Tedx Speaker and an Educator. 

I talk about human potential and help people DO life better with my 1:1 coaching sessions and online education. 

Explore topics like Communication, self-doubt, Soft-skills, overthinking, procrastination, confidence, and all things personal development! 

I also post special SUNDAY QnA's (KAHO/POOCHO) on my Instagram (we are a family of close to half a million people! ) where you can share your current problem with me that I answer through an Instagram story! 

You will walk out of here feeling more relieved and with an increased sense of CLARITY and Competence!

In Personal development coaching practice and Soft-skills training, I specialize in Personality Study, Perspective Reframing/Cognitive Restructuring and Performance Management.


❤️‍🩹In our community, we intensely focus on Personal accountability/responsibility. Focus on perspective reframing and work on factors you can control rather than waste time and energy on factors you can't control :) 

✅We follow a format of Mindset + Technique to solve any problem.
